question: are there any cultural clubs at ramapo? like for south asian or caribbean students
answer:
Yes. Ramapo’s culturally based student organizations include [Students of Caribbean Ancestry (SOCA)](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/students-caribbean-ancestry-soca/) and [South Asian Club](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/). [15] SOCA promotes understanding of Caribbean culture, history and politics through weekly meetings and programs, and seeks to include all people of Caribbean ancestry. [12] South Asian Club aims to bring South Asians together and share awareness of South Asian culture. [9]

Other related options include [Naach](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/), a dance club teaching South Asian dances that welcomes anyone interested, [13] and [United Asian Association](https://archway.ramapo.edu/UAA/), which advocates for and educates about the Asian-Pacific Islander American diaspora. [7] Their categories are Student Organization (SOCA, South Asian Club, and United Asian Association) and Student Organization - Arts, Community, Cultural, Social (Naach). [2][3][4][7] The directory gives 7 clubs in these categories. [1] All clubs listed on the College page are open to students. [11]

Culture Club is not currently active, according to the page as of 6/12/25. [8] For help finding a group or starting one, contact the Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [11]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/) [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SOCA/) [3](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SAC/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Naach/) [7](https://archway.ramapo.edu/UAA/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/culture-club/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/students-caribbean-ancestry-soca/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/oabc/home/you-belong-at-ramapo/)
note_A: SOCA, South Asian Club, Naach and United Asian Association are all in the directory with the stated categories, and their descriptions match their club pages; Culture Club is marked inactive as of 6/12/25 and the CSI contact (csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202) is right. The claim that 'the directory gives 7 clubs in these categories' has no support: Student Organization alone has 109.
note_B: SOCA, South Asian Club, Naach and UAA are all in the directory with the stated categories, and their descriptions match the club pages; Culture Club's page says it has been inactive since 6/12/25. The 'directory gives 7 clubs in these categories' line and the category recital are unclear filler that nobody asked for.

I don’t have verified information about which club is “best.” The closest dorm-focused match is Ramapo College Residence Life (Residence Life - Community, Social): its listed benefit is “Joining the awesome on campus living community at Ramapo College.” [4] Other listed clubs closest by meaning are: Culture Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/; The Meep Meeps-Orientation Group 3 (Office Sponsored Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/OG3/; Sports Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sport/ (“Meet new friends!”); Spanish Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/SpanClub/; Disney Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/RDC/; Ping Pong Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/ping/; Ramapo Gamers Club (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCES/. [1] The college suggests joining a club or organization, and says clubs can provide “interesting friends.” [10, 13] For help choosing, contact the Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [13]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/ResLife/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/)
note_A: Declines 'best' (advice) appropriately; every club named exists in the directory with the stated category and URL (Ramapo College Residence Life with benefit 'Joining the awesome on campus living community', Culture Club, Meep Meeps OG3, Sports Club 'Meet new friends!', Spanish, Disney, Ping Pong, Ramapo Gamers Club). Clubs page says joining provides 'interesting friends'; CSI contact correct.
note_B: Declining to name the 'best' club is fine. Every club named is in the directory with the stated category and URL. The Residence Life benefit text and the Sports Club 'Meet new friends!' match the clubs artifact, and the /clubs/ page does mention 'interesting friends'.

question: when does the club that does the late night movie nights actually meet
answer:
